description: This file defines a class 'EligibleLeaveTypeAPI' which serves as an API endpoint to retrieve eligible leave types for an employee within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for fetching data and validation rules, and leverages traits for authentication and leave type services.

classes.name: EligibleLeaveTypeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing methods to retrieve eligible leave types for an employee, extending the base Endpoint class and implementing CollectionEndpoint.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of eligible leave types for an employee, using provided or default employee number and includeAllocated flag.
